description: This file defines the RequestInterface in the PSR-7 HTTP message standard, specifying the methods for handling HTTP request properties such as request target, method, URI, and headers.

classes.name: RequestInterface
classes.description: Defines a contract for HTTP request objects, including methods for retrieving and setting request target, method, URI, with emphasis on immutability.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the message's request target, returning either the origin-form, absolute-form, authority-form, or a specific string if set.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified request target, ensuring immutability.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the provided HTTP method, ensuring immutability.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Retrieves the URI object associated with the request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI, optionally preserving the Host header.
